title: Work IQ: agents select the most relevant skills for each request
summary: The roadmap details, published Work IQ licensing rules, and package-management controls are supported. The briefing appropriately leaves dynamic-selection defaults and controls unconfirmed; its discussion of related business skills should identify that capability as preview.
